title: Canceled bond projects, by bond year
subtitle: KXAN's count from the city's new bond dashboard; a city memo counts 61
source: KXAN, from the Austin Bond Dashboard
alt: Bar chart of canceled voter-approved bond projects as counted by KXAN from the City of Austin's bond dashboard: 20 from the 2016 transportation bond, 27 from the 2018 bond, 16 from the 2020 transportation bond and 3 from the 2022 affordable housing bond. A city memo cited by CBS Austin counts 61 canceled projects of 1,426.
